6516.title: Detached touch targets leave scroll corrections pending
6516.rootCauseOneLine: Removing a touch-start descendant prevents its completion event from reaching the keeper, leaving deferred scroll correction stuck behind touching=true.

prReviews.verdict: Plausible root-cause fix; static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Target-level touch completion listeners address the observed mechanism; linked code was not run.

6516.proposedFix: Track touch completion on each actual start target and remove those listeners on completion/disconnect. Avoid a duplicate of open PR #6517.
6516.caveats: Component mechanism repeated in two clean main checkouts. Native iOS gestures, full timeline pagination, screenshots, and persistence until reopening remain unverified.
